description: Elections Commission - Declare that H. M. Muthubanda as a Member of the Kanthale Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kanthale Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority position, including the resignation of a member and the nomination of a replacement by the group leader. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7), which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
